commitPolicy: One finding per commit; one final push after all fixes and local verification.

findings.implementation: Check final UTF-8 JSON bytes against the same 8 MB read limit before atomic replacement; share the check with portable package files and render snapshots. Keep the original file and revision on rejection.
findings.red: New valid dense-project edit regression failed because save returned success instead of project-size.
findings.green: All 13 soundtrack integration lifecycle tests passed; oversized save leaves exact original bytes, readable revision 0, and no temporary file or lock.

findings.implementation: Queue render publication/pruning and Lab edits by real project path; hold the shared artifact lock for the full preview mutation to exclude independent Lab instances. Release queues and locks after failures.
findings.red: Two deterministic mocked-worker regressions failed: concurrent renders retained no published output, and an edit during rendering left an obsolete preview published.
findings.green: Eight concurrency and real-worker HTTP API tests pass, including one retained newest preview, edit invalidation after publication, render failure recovery, independent-server exclusion and normal stale/checksum checks. TypeScript build and focused ESLint pass.
